_readme: Golden schedules transcribed from real planners (MultiDeco, Shearwater
Cloud Desktop, on-unit Petrel/Perdix planner). Fill 'expected' for a dive
after planning EXACTLY the same profile there:
- same GF low/high, descent/ascent rate, last stop depth
- bottom_time_min counts from the start of the descent (runtime)
- Shearwater: Salinity = EN13319 (default); MultiDeco: salt water
Record the planner + version in 'source'. Dives with expected: null are
reported as skipped tests until filled in.
p_h2o (bar) to match the source planner's water-vapour constant
do; Buhlmann's own 0.0627 is what Subsurface passes).
_multideco_provenance: The four 45m dives below are transcribed from MultiDeco screenshots taken
2026-07-10 (multideco_screenshots/ in the repo root): dive #1, OC, bottom
gas air, deco EAN50 @21m + O2 @6m, with the gas-loss scenario table
(columns OK / lost 50 / lost 100 / both lost). The settings panel was not
captured; GF 35/75 + ZHL-16C + descent 10 m/min + P_H2O 0.0567 were
inferred by parameter scan - the no-loss schedule matches eko-deco
EXACTLY under those settings and the three loss columns agree within
1-2 min/stop. If you still have the plan, confirm GF in Konf and update
this note. tts here = runtime shown by MultiDeco minus 25 min bottom.

dives.name: SW Predator 32m/40min EAN28 +EAN50+O2 GF5/50
dives.source: Shearwater Predator on-unit planner, photographed 2026-08-07 - settings READ OFF THE UNIT, transcribed in _predator_provenance above
dives._note: The same dive as the MultiDeco export above (examples/scenario_2), now from a real Shearwater — the two references agree with each other and with us on the obligation below 15 m, and differ from us in the same place. Tolerances are wide for the SAME TWO KNOWN reasons as the GF40/85 Predator entry, both recorded rather than tuned away. (1) The Predator prints the leg (runtime difference, ascent included) while this test compares the hold. (2) We add 21 m / 18 m pass-through stops worth ~1 min that neither the Predator nor MultiDeco makes: at GF-Low 5 the ceiling relaxes faster than the diver ascends, so Baker's rule (DECISIONS #21) becomes visible padding instead of obligation — suppressing it on a 1-minute grid reproduces this schedule exactly. Gas volumes are NOT asserted: the Predator stays on the bottom gas to 15 m (its first stop) while we switch at EAN50's 21.9 m MOD, which is DECISIONS #27 and a convention, not a model difference. CNS does NOT match (51% theirs vs 36.7% ours) and is deliberately not asserted; see the dive_parameters.md write-up and DECISIONS #27.

dives.name: SW Predator 32m/40min EAN32 +EAN50+O2 GF40/85
dives.source: Shearwater Predator on-unit planner, photographed 2026-08-07 - settings READ OFF THE UNIT, transcribed in _predator_provenance above
dives._note: Tolerances are wide for two KNOWN reasons, both recorded rather than tuned away. (1) The Predator prints the leg (difference of runtimes, ascent included) while this test compares the hold, so every stop reads ~0.3 min short on our side — the same bookkeeping gap the Perdix 2 fixture carries. (2) We add 12 m (1.00 min) and 9 m (0.70 min) pass-through stops that are pure Baker runtime padding, not obligation: the GF-high ceiling was already clear of the next stop at both (DECISIONS #21). The obligation itself is identical — the 6 m and 3 m legs match exactly and the O2 volume matches to the litre. CNS does NOT match (38% theirs vs 32.3% ours) and is deliberately not asserted here; see the dive_parameters.md write-up.

_shearwater_provenance: The 40m/20min dive is the official worked example from the Shearwater
OC, EAN28 bottom + EAN50 deco, planner settings screen shows GF 30/70,
Last Stop 3m, RMV 15; manual states descent 18 m/min, ascent 10 m/min,
Run 34 min, Deco 14 min, gas 28%: 1534 L, 50%: 287 L. Shearwater's
displayed stop minutes absorb the inter-stop ascent fractions (runtime
bookkeeping), hence the 1 min tolerance on stops while run/TTS match
exactly. The 30m/30min walkthrough on p.30 was evaluated and REJECTED
as golden data: its table is truncated mid-schedule (runtime shown is
inconsistent with the in-dive TTS on the same pages).
_predator_provenance: The two 32 m / 40 min SW Predator dives below are real on-unit planner runs,
photographed 2026-08-07 and transcribed here. Unlike the MultiDeco 45 m set,
the settings are NOT inferred - they were read off the unit's own screens.
The photographs are kept outside the repo (~/eko-deco-evidence/); this block
and the per-dive _note fields are the evidence of record.
Read off the screens, both dives: OC planner, depth 32 m, time 40 min,
RMV 20 L/min, start CNS 0 %, last stop 3 m, gases 99/00 + 50/00 + bottom mix.
GF 40/85 on one (Deco Setup + Display Setup: Meters, Altitude SeaLvl) and
GF 5/50 on the other (main display 'Conserv. 05/50' and ready-to-plan
'GF: 5/50'). NOT shown on any screen, so not established: salinity, the
ppO2 switch limits, and - on the GF 40/85 dive - the ascent rate.
What the printed gas column settles, and it is the useful part of the
capture. Every Qty on the GF 5/50 dive is reproduced exactly by
RMV x minutes x (1.0 + depth/10), stop legs charged at the stop depth for
the whole leg and ascent legs at mean depth over a whole number of minutes:
Three conventions follow:
* The gas arithmetic uses surface 1.000 bar and exactly 10 m/bar. Whether
the MODEL does is still open - this is a display convention, as in
MultiDeco.
* Bottom time INCLUDES the descent. The bottom row prints 3259 L where
40 min at 32 m would be 3360; the 101 L deficit is a 3.2 min descent at
10 m/min inside the 40. Same convention as ours, MultiDeco, GFDECO and
Subsurface.
* Descent and ascent are 10 m/min on a whole-minute grid - the 17 m ascent
is billed as 2 min (1.7 rounded up), which is why Run steps 40 -> 42.
Printed totals not pinned by the schedule assertions, kept for reference:
99/00 194 L; schedule 6m 2' @45, 3m 5' @50. EAN50 reads 0 L
because the unit's first stop is 6 m, where O2 beats it.
The three divergences these two dives establish - pass-through stops, the
gas-switch depth, and the CNS clock - are DECISIONS #27. None is fitted away.
_scenario_provenance: The eight 32 m / 40 min dives below come from two real MultiDeco 4.24
plans exported in Polish, kept verbatim in examples/scenario_1/data.txt
and examples/scenario_2/data.txt. Unlike the 45 m set above, the settings
are NOT inferred: the export prints GF (40/85 and 5/50), the descent and
ascent rates (8 and 9 m/min) and the gas stack. Each scenario contributes
four dives - the plan itself plus the three columns of its own
'utrata gazu' (lost gas) table: lost EAN50, lost O2, both lost.
Stop times are transcribed from that table, in whole minutes. Two
MultiDeco printing conventions to know when comparing by eye:
* its segment time for a stop INCLUDES the ascent to that stop, so the
STOP column always equals the runtime delta (see DECISIONS.md #17);
eko-deco's stop durations are the hold alone and therefore read up to
one ascent (~0.33 min) shorter per stop.
* the first stop is padded so the runtime lands on a whole minute - the
'0:27' rows at 9 m (scenario 1) and 18 m (scenario 2), printed as 0 in
the loss table. They are a rounding artifact, not an obligation, and
are left out of 'stops' here.
tts_min is MultiDeco's printed surface runtime minus the 40 min bottom.
p_h2o 0.0567 is MultiDeco's own (Schreiner) water-vapour constant; it
tightens the agreement on the long columns and changes nothing on the
short ones. Environment: both plans were made for FRESH water at 150 m
altitude, and the printed ppO2/ead/density pin that display to surface
1.0 bar + 10.33 m/bar (tests/test_multideco_scenarios.py checks we
reproduce those figures exactly with --water fresh --surface-p 1.0).
The SCHEDULE, however, matches eko-deco's sea-level salt defaults far
better than those constants do - MultiDeco appears to apply fresh water
and altitude to its displayed pressures but not to the model - so these
fixtures deliberately run at the defaults. Tolerances are set just above
the deltas actually measured, so any drift trips the test.
